method: Selected public source records, not verified distinct tenancies. Full dated BBB originals and archived apartments.com reviews replace matching search-index snippets; residual snippets are partial. Capture type and source_file identify provenance. No Rent.com or Reddit records were admitted. Dates describe publication unless move_out_date explicitly records an event date. Review date is never treated as proof of governing law. Names/handles are omitted; exact quotes and response excerpts are checked against saved captures.
